notes.title: Holy Chick! Patch 0.6
notes.notes:
Hello Chicken Evaders! Time for a new patch!

- Fixed issue with vacuum cleaner
- Fixed crash after leaving to Main Menu
- Objectives now have higher resolution
- Master Volume decreased by 20%
- More immersive game start fade-ins

We are aware there are some other minor issues still present, and we'll do our best to address them as soon as possible! Thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: Holy Chick! Patch 0.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

As you may have noticed Patch 0.5 is now live - we come with fixes and new features!

Full Patchnotes


 Added a shooting range in the laboratory
 Added a piano puzzle
 Added a table illustrating the Loot Buster creation process (included a hint)
 Added a sliding cabinet with vacuum cleaners
 Improved player navigation
 Improved light optimization
 Fixed pickup lag while holding an item
 Fixed credits being displayed incorrectly
 Fixed reported sound issues 
 Reworked Loot Buster (should be more intuitive)
 Reworked the shooting range
 Components for the Merge Machine can now be found in more intuitive places
 Minor physics adjustments


Once again, huge thank you everyone for your feedback! We are very grateful for your support and detailed reports! More updates are on the horizon!

Until next time! 🐔

notes.title: Critical Hotfix Live
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've successfully launched Holy Chick! and today we deliver a critical hotfix:

 Fixed issue with turning, your view will no longer keep spinning
 Items that fall out of player reach will reappear in their initial finding spot


Thank you everyone for checking out our game! More updates are coming, but in the meantime we encourage you to voice your opinions and suggestions in the Steam discussions!
